profile_md: Imperial's strongest employer-linked group provision sits in the Business School and a few engineering/environment programmes, with no institution-wide scheme found. The Business School's MSc Group Consulting Projects (June-July 2026 call; 4-5 weeks; teams of 5-7 from seven MSc programmes) take real briefs from companies, which are free to participate; students bid for them and present recommendations to a panel including company representatives. These run as elective capstone options (e.g. Strategic Marketing Consulting Project BUSI70292, 10 ECTS; Business Analytics & AI; Management; Economics & Strategy; Climate Change, Management & Finance). The MBA equivalent (Perspectives on Practice) is individual. In science, the MSc Environmental Technology (EAM option) Hounslow Heath project is a group technical report for Hounslow Borough Council with team presentations to the client (2025-26 specification). In engineering, the EEE third-year MEng group project (industry-proposed, groups of 5-7, industrial and academic supervisors) and the Computing Year 3 Software Engineering Group Project (customers, many industry-proposed) are strong leads, but current-year delivery or share of external clients is unconfirmed; Civil and Transport MSc group design projects mention clients/industry without detail. I-Explore/Horizons modules lack external partners. Access is programme-by-programme: provision is distributed across schools and not university-wide. Uncertain: current-year evidence for engineering routes, extracurricular employer challenges, and Medicine/Natural Sciences coverage.
gaps: Further departmental instances likely (e.g. Bioengineering, Materials, Chemical Engineering, Earth Science, Physics/Chemistry industry projects, Faculty of Medicine). Extracurricular employer-set challenges (Careers competitions such as Accuracy Business Cup, Siemens/Sony) and the Imperial College Consultancy Society not verified. Credit weightings, module codes and cohort sizes mostly not extracted (search summaries only; no verbatim page quotes for most). Current-year evidence needed for S5, S6, S7, S9, S10. UROP/internship routes were not examined (individual).
